title: 第一卷 风起时 第二十三章 风骨第一卷 风起时 第二十四章 仙子堕凡尘
content_zh:
;;
兵冢山此次为了采摘九尺灵光宝药，来了足足有十七人，可以说是倾巢而出了。
除了离去的祝山与蚕牙，以及一开始被异兽重创的那人之外，余下的还有十四人。
再加上刚被陈风奇踹飞出去的一个，已经陷入昏死状态。
此刻围向陈风奇的，还有十三个。
虽说里面大多数凝气五层的修行者都有伤在身，但基本都不严重，对战力没有太大影响。
不过最难缠的，还是那五位凝气六层的修行者。
在陈风奇正打算离开这个是非之地时，有一位中年女子忽然双眸泛光，竟发出一道类似精神冲击的异术。
陈风奇只觉大脑忽然被锤子砸了一下，出现了短暂的昏沉感，动作也陷入了迟滞。
当他回过神来的时候，一位壮硕男子已经冲到面前，整个人高高跃起，将一柄巨大的战锤举过头顶，直直就砸落下来。
陈风奇心中一沉，抬起双手准备抵挡。
虽说对方这一锤看上去很重，但他其实一点不惧。
若比力量，即便对方是凝气六层，他不带怕的。
真正让他在意的，其实是从侧方向攻来的另外两人。
所以他打算利用壮硕男子的这一锤之力，让自己先摆脱包围圈。
然而就在此时，谁也没有预料到的事情发生了。
有一抹金光，出现在所有人的视线余光之中。
随后一道全身散发着金光的身影，以极其恐怖的速度，几乎是瞬间出现在陈风奇面前。
然后，一拳轰在了壮硕男子的面颊上。
陈风奇看得最清楚，却也最难以置信，一双眼睛已经瞪得老大，里面全是不可思议。

这道突然出现的金光身影，是他即便绞尽脑汁，也不可能会想到的人。
“风骨？！”
思索只在一瞬间。
壮硕男子的大铁锤还没有抡下去，就已经被金光身影一拳轰飞出去老远。
在场所有人，都被这突然出现的身影惊住，一时忘记了行动。
实在是因为来人，太过古怪。
他身上散发着一层淡淡的金光，可一身血肉已经糜烂，显露出金灿灿的骨骼。
甚至能透过骨骼血肉见的缝隙，看到里面的内脏都早已腐烂。
按道理说，一个人的身体腐烂到如此程度，怎么都不可能还活着才对，更不可能一拳将一个凝气六层的大汉打飞出去。
可偏偏，他做到了。
并在下一刻，他再次动了。
只见他源于骨头内散发的金光更亮，然后猛地向前，继续朝着刚被他轰飞的壮硕男子攻去。
“哈哈……风骨！”
陈风奇忍不住惊笑一声，确信自己没有认错。
尽管对方那张脸已经腐烂得不成样子，可还是能从轮廓中，看出不少与陈风奇相似的地方。
以及彼此那份血脉的牵连，陈风奇又怎能认错？
content_en:
;;
A total of seventeen people came to Bingzhong Mountain to pick the nine-foot spiritual light treasure this time. It can be said that they turned out in full force.
In addition to Zhu Shan and Canya who left, as well as the person who was severely injured by the alien beast at the beginning, there were fourteen people left.
In addition, the one who had just been kicked out by Chen Fengqi was already in a coma.
At this moment, there were thirteen others surrounding Chen Fengqi.
Although most of the practitioners at the fifth level of Qi Condensation inside were injured, they were basically not serious and did not have much impact on their combat effectiveness.
But the most difficult ones are the five practitioners at the sixth level of Qi Condensation.
When Chen Fengqi was about to leave this place of right and wrong, a middle-aged woman's eyes suddenly shone brightly, and she actually unleashed a strange technique similar to a mental shock.
Chen Fengqi felt that his brain was suddenly hit by a hammer. He felt briefly dizzy and his movements were sluggish.
当他回过神来的时候，一位壮硕男子已经冲到面前，整个人高高跃起，将一柄巨大的战锤举过头顶，直直就砸落下来。
Chen Fengqi's heart sank, and he raised his hands to resist.
Although the opponent's blow looked heavy, he was actually not afraid at all.
If compared with strength, even if the opponent is at the sixth level of Qi Condensation, he is not afraid.
What really concerned him was the other two people attacking from the side.
So he planned to use the power of the strong man's hammer to get himself out of the encirclement first.
However, at this moment, something no one expected happened.
A golden light appeared in the corner of everyone's sight.
Then a figure with golden light all over its body appeared in front of Chen Fengqi almost instantly at an extremely terrifying speed.
Then, he punched the strong man in the cheek.
Chen Fengqi saw it most clearly, but also the most unbelievable. His eyes were wide open, filled with incredible things.
This golden figure that suddenly appeared was someone he couldn't have thought of even if he racked his brains.
"Character?!"
Thinking only for a moment.
Before the strong man could swing his big hammer down, he was already punched away by the golden figure and flew far away.
Everyone present was shocked by the sudden appearance and forgot to take action for a moment.
It's really because the person coming is too weird.
His body exuded a faint golden light, but his flesh and blood had been corroded, revealing his golden bones.
You can even see through the gaps between the bones and flesh that the internal organs inside have long since rotted.
按道理说，一个人的身体腐烂到如此程度，怎么都不可能还活着才对，更不可能一拳将一个凝气六层的大汉打飞出去。
But, he did it.
并在下一刻，他再次动了。
I saw the golden light emanating from his bones getting brighter, and then he suddenly moved forward and continued to attack the strong man who had just been blasted away by him.
“哈哈……风骨！”
Chen Fengqi couldn't help but laugh in surprise, convinced that he had not admitted his mistake.
Although the other person's face was rotten to the point of disgrace, one could still see a lot of similarities with Chen Fengqi from the outline.
And how could Chen Fengqi admit his mistake because of their blood ties?
